Wave 49 — the red-square hole: an INSTRUMENT finding plus the conformance defects it exposed.

HEADLINE (measurement, not a fix). The scorer's colour veto is gated on colorDivergent =
whole-canvas per-channel histogram KL > 0.1 (inject-wpt-block.mjs). That metric is
coverage-weighted, so a TOTAL hue swap confined to a small area cannot move it. Consequence,
measured over all 30 sections: WPT "test passes if there is a filled green square" tests where
our runtimes paint the RED FAIL square score SSIM up to 1.0000 and are recorded as PASSES.
Canonical instance css-view-transitions/hit-test-unrelated-element, all three platforms:
ssim 1.0000, wptPass TRUE, colorDivergent FALSE, yet fuzzyDifferingPixels 10000 at
fuzzyMaxChannelDelta 255 — the instrument already measured the whole square at full channel
delta and passed it.

CENSUS (orchestrator and lane I1 computed it independently; EXACT agreement, zero set
difference): 179 currently-passing cells paint red where the reference has essentially none
(web 26, iOS 67, Android 86) across 102 tests; 89 currently-FAILING cells carry the same
signature (web 13, iOS 37, Android 39) across 53 tests. The orchestrator's first count of 101
honest fails was WRONG — 12 of those rows are scoreExcluded (extraction-wall tests the scorer
never gates on). 89 is the correct figure and is what this wave's fix lanes drew from.

THE CHECK DID NOT SHIP ARMED. I1 built a novel-ink veto (share of divergent ink whose CIEDE2000
distance to the reference's palette, closed under pairwise sRGB blending, exceeds 20;
area-normalized on the DIVERGENT REGION, which is exactly what histogram KL gets wrong;
colour-agnostic — nothing names a hue or WPT prose). Decision rule fixed BEFORE measuring:
recall >= 95%, false-positive <= 2% on >= 40 hand-verified correct renders, and a mutation test
proving it can fail. MEASURED ONCE: (c) passes; (b) clears at 0/51 confirmed-correct renders;
(a) MISSES — 66.7% recall on the census-selected defect set, and only 16.7% on an unbiased
sample. The honest figure is the second. So it ships OFF behind TITAN_NOVEL_INK_VETO=1, stamped
on every diff for triage but never feeding wptPass. Two measured miss mechanisms: wrong-colour-
AND-displaced renders fill the divergent region with the reference's own palette; small marks
clear the fraction bar but not the mass bar. The successor needs a displacement-aware
denominator — a redesign with its own pre-registered rule, not a threshold tune.

SIDE FINDING, larger than what the wave fixed: of 78 randomly-drawn PASSING cells opened by eye,
27 (35%) are visibly wrong renders — wrong colour, wrong position, wrong line breaking, missing
glyphs ("PASS" rendered "ASS"; "A. B. C." rendered "0. 1. 2."). The red-square class is one
visible slice of a much wider degeneracy in the pass column, and no colour-based check reaches
the rest.

GATE RESULT: 32 cells gained, ZERO lost, over 4111 scored cells with exact column parity
(4111 old / 4111 new). web 1201->1205 (+4), iOS 1066->1081 (+15), Android 1045->1058 (+13).
24 of 25 predicted flips hit; 8 gains were unpredicted.

MECHANISMS:
- clip-path on the document element (A4): 0.5367 -> BYTE-IDENTICAL to the reference on all three
  platforms (7500 green px, bbox [66,66]-[165,165] — verified by ink geometry, not the pass flag,
  because a bounding-box-shaped clip would have scored 0.9838 and passed while being wrong).
- Obligation #3 DISCHARGED: clip-path-blending-offset Android 0.9566 -> 1.0000. PR #126's
  BlendModeApplier saveLayer-bounds fix was NOT reverted (verified); the pre-existing ancestor-
  clip defect it un-hid is now fixed rather than re-hidden.
- currentcolor + static color-mix (A5): claimed 2 cells, moved 8. color-mix-currentcolor-001/002
  reached a perfect 1.0 on both natives; these were presence-veto cells painting ink where the
  browser paints none.
- image() candidate chain (A3): the wire already carried the full srcs list; both natives read
  only the first. 6 cells. Verified NOT degenerate — white holds at 82.1%, so the fix resolves
  the right candidate rather than painting nothing.
- Invalid declarations are now DROPPED, not emitted as a raw passthrough (A1/F3):
  attr-namespace-non-existing flips on all three. Full-corpus differential: 1432 identical,
  3 changed, and 440 non-WPT fixtures byte-identical, so no committed baseline can move.

SSIM IS BLIND TO THIS ENTIRE CLASS — the wave's own evidence, in both directions. Genuine
conformance repairs landed with the metric frozen (position-relative-006 iOS 0.9974->0.9974;
fallbacks-002 iOS 0.9990->0.9990) and, in one case, moving BACKWARDS while the render became
correct (before-as-flex-container iOS 0.9990 -> 0.9986, fail -> PASS). Only the colour veto saw
any of it.

PREDICTION MISS (1 of 25), diagnosed: position-relative-006 Android. Not a defect — A7's Compose
PercentInsetResolve declines by design when the ancestor publishes no containing block on either
axis, because it cannot distinguish CSS-indefinite (resolve to zero, css-position-3 relpos-insets)
from a channel gap. The iOS twin flips because SwiftUI's LayoutAggregate publishes one.
The prediction was optimistic; the code is right. Spec-true repair located: the Compose
renderer's LocalContainingBlock provider should republish for non-block-container ancestors
(CSS 2.1 section 10.1).

HONEST NEGATIVES: angle-units-001 still fails on all three — A1 proved the green declaration dies
in tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs's last-wins declaration collapse (a bare props[k]=v with no
validity oracle) BEFORE the converter sees it, and refused to claim the flip; the orchestrator
deferred that extractor patch as corpus-wide blast radius for 3 cells. clip-path-contentBox-1d/1e
still fail on Android. css-transform-3d-transform-style Android passes at 0.9577 against iOS's
0.9574 — it converges on iOS's known-wrong render, does NOT read transform-style, and is labelled
an approximation in OrthographicFlatten rather than presented as implementing preserve-3d; treat
it as fragile.

SKEPTIC YIELD (six adversarial lanes, executed repros): a GATE-CRITICAL unguarded
IllegalArgumentException on 3 corpus documents at a composition site with no error boundary
(would have crashed the capture Activity and taken out the css-masking Android column — root
cause: ClipPathExtractor read circle/ellipse centres as JSON primitives where the converter's
deepFlatten emits IRLength objects); an INERT lane (A2's PseudoBoxFold had no call site, and what
landed only removed render output — its Android cell exists only because F2 then wired it and
backed it with a reachability test carrying a negative control); converter FALSE POSITIVES
dropping valid CSS (scientific-notation angles, a direction keyword written with two spaces) from
a residual verdict that was unsound by construction; and 300 wrong spec-citation occurrences
across 23 distinct references in 82 files, including two FABRICATED quotes — sentences in
quotation marks appearing nowhere in the cited spec.

RING-FENCE: filter-effects/backdrop-filter-basic-blur is UNTOUCHED — identical SSIM to 4dp and
identical pass state on all three platforms (web 0.9943 P, iOS 0.9469 f, Android 0.8990 f).

327-net: exit 0, 109 captures on each of three platforms, baseline gate clean.
Instrument additions: assertPlatformColumns (BACKLOG obligation #5) plus a runtime column-presence
guard in the gate script — the 327-net once passed with the whole Android column silently
skipped, and this wave now catches that in two independent places. Both were exercised for real:
the first wave-49 gate attempt produced an Android-less section (host disk hit 94%, destabilising
the emulator into an adb Broken pipe during installDebug) and was caught after ONE section.
